# Redalyc

> Redalyc is a Latin American open-access scientific journal indexing network and platform providing free access to peer-reviewed research across multiple disciplines.

Redalyc (Red de Revistas Científicas de América Latina y el Caribe) operates as a diamond open-access model, aggregating academic journals primarily from Latin America and Spain. The platform includes Marcalyc, an editorial workflow tool for XML-JATS markup and journal management, supporting the scholarly publishing ecosystem across the region.

## Core Platform

- [Sistema de Información Científica Redalyc](https://redalyc.org): Redalyc homepage: open-access scientific journal network and indexing system
- [Redalyc Main Portal](http://www.redalyc.org): Redalyc main portal: scientific journal network with open-access diamond model
- [¿Qué es Redalyc.org?](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/mision.html): Redalyc mission statement and organizational overview of scientific indexing system

## Editorial Tools & Workflow

- [Marcalyc - Editorial Workflow Platform](http://marcalyc.redalyc.org): Marcalyc editorial workflow platform for XML-JATS markup and journal management
- [Aprende a usar Marcalyc](http://marcalyc.redalyc.org/ayuda): Marcalyc user guide: tutorials for XML-JATS markup, article prep, and DOI linking

## Journal Submission & Indexing

- [Postula tu revista](https://redalyc.org/postulacion.oa): Journal submission process and evaluation criteria for Redalyc indexing

## Research & Analysis

- [Periscopio Redalyc](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/periscopio/inicio.html): Periscopio: Redalyc journal directory and Latin American research analysis
- [Iniciativa de Ley en México para el Acceso Abierto](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/acceso-abierto/iniciativaOA_Mx.html): Mexico open-access legislation initiative for publicly-funded research results

## Legal & Governance

- [Uso legal](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/usolegal.html): Redalyc legal terms, copyright, and open-access usage rights
- [Consejo Asesor](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/consejoAsesor.html): Redalyc-AmeliCA advisory board members and leadership governance
- [Consejo de Evaluación de Revistas Redalyc - AmeliCA](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/consejoEvaluador.html): Redalyc-AmeliCA journal evaluation board members and peer-review leadership

## Optional

- [Reconocimientos internacionales](https://redalyc.org/redalyc/acerca-de/reconocimientos.html): International awards and recognition received by Redalyc organization
